'''Had al'Lora''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident who became a member of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Had al'Lora}} 

== Appearance ==
He is lean with a thick mustache styled in the [[Taraboner]] fashion.

== Activities ==
He accompanied [[Perrin Aybara]] into [[Ghealdan]] to track down [[Masema Dagar]]. He later passed through an aqueduct to enter the town of [[Malden]] to help Perrin free [[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara|his wife]] from captivity by the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].  Had then participated in the subsequent [[Battle of Malden]].
